<?php
class QuietStringPayload {
    public function __toString(): string {
        global $payload, $reader;
        echo "CAST;";
        $payload = null;
        $reader = null;
        return "0";
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "PAYLOAD;"; }
}
class QuietStringObjectGet {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "ISSET;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): string { global $payload; echo "GET;"; return $payload; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
$payload = new QuietStringPayload;
$reader = new QuietStringObjectGet;
$selector = "zero";
$destination = 42;
$destination = empty($reader->$selector);
echo $destination === true ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD_RESULT;";
echo $payload === null ? "PAYLOAD_CLEAR;" : "BAD_PAYLOAD;";
echo $reader === null ? "READER_CLEAR;" : "BAD_READER;";
echo $selector === "zero" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
